paraphrase: Church 1949: given three observation-statements O1, O2, O3 none of which taken alone entails any of the others, any statement S whatever is such that either it or its negation is verifiable under Ayer's 1946 definition, by way of the directly verifiable statement (not-O1 and O2) or (O3 and not-S).
